title: emc2 layer
description: A layer of map objects. Background maps are not layers in this sense; they belong to the map view and background map plugins. '$defs/content' is the part a change request carries. Data model 1.9.0 (PDA), see model/README.md.

drawOrder.description: Higher values are drawn on top. A number rather than an integer, so a layer can be moved between two others by changing only its own value. Ties are broken by id.

workspace.description: Data model 1.2.0 (ADR-0039): the workspace the layer belongs to, e.g. simulator.simulation. Absent means View (core.view), which the store keeps as absent; writers may send core.view. Set on create. On update an absent workspace keeps the stored one (an exception to rule 5), and an explicit one must equal it: a layer stays in its workspace.

locked.description: Data model 1.3.0 (ADR-0042): the layer is locked. Absent or false: not locked; the store keeps false as absent, and readers treat both alike. On update an absent locked keeps the stored value (an exception to rule 5), true sets it and false clears it. Setting or clearing it needs the layer's edit permission. While it is set, the store refuses a user's change to the layer's content with LAYER_LOCKED; see model/README.md.
